name: init-community-game-framework
description: Scaffolds an empty GitHub repository with a dual-licensing structure and an automated Contributor License Agreement (CLA) workflow.

context.goal: Allow community contributions while legally preventing commercialization of the code and assets.

requirements: Create a file named 'LICENSE-CODE' and populate it with the full text of the PolyForm Noncommercial 1.0 license.
Create a file named 'LICENSE-ASSETS' and populate it with the full text of the CC BY-NC 4.0 license.
Create a root 'LICENSE' file that explicitly explains this dual-license structure and points to the two specific files.
Add a section explaining how the community can contribute code vs. assets.
Add a mandatory section explaining that all contributors must sign the CLA, which will be automatically checked on their Pull Request.
Create a file named 'cla.yml' inside the workflows directory.
Populate 'cla.yml' using the standard 'cla-assistant/github-action' workflow template. Configure it to trigger on 'issue_comment' and 'pull_request_target'.
Include placeholder environment variables for 'GITHUB_TOKEN' and 'PERSONAL_ACCESS_TOKEN'.
Generate a professional 'README.md' for a game project.
Include a 'Licensing' section that clearly explains the dual-license model (Code is source-available/non-commercial, Assets are CC BY-NC 4.0) so players and developers understand the boundaries.
Include a 'How to Contribute' section linking to CONTRIBUTING.md.
